notes: Corrections per mask audit: (1) normalize(row) now takes row['prompt'] (or, only when it is absent, the shared message prefix of chosen/rejected up to their final assistant turn) and appends it exactly once; only the FINAL assistant message of chosen/rejected is used as the response, so any user turns duplicated inside those arrays are no longer scored inside the assistant mask. (2) The assistant response string includes the chat template's terminator because it is produced as the exact prefix-suffix difference of add_generation_prompt=True vs full render. (3) preferences.json / train_preferences.json pairs now key on original row IDs (row.get('id'|'prompt_id'|'uid'), fallback to index). (4) encode_pair now returns a `truncated` flag; run.json reports `truncated_rows` and `identical_truncated_rows` (rows whose chosen/rejected become identical after truncation) honestly rather than hiding them. (5) Real log-prob recomputation over true assistant tokens only, beta=0.1 DPO with real backward on all 32 pairs (each used >=1 time, per-row counts saved in training_state.pt as steps_used_per_row), AdamW optimizer state, RNG, and reference-binding hash saved; validation 8 pairs scored after training. (6) evaluate reloads and recomputes with the same row IDs. All benchmark contract items (CUDA required, --help without model load, doctor exit 0/78 with hash checks, checkpoint/training_state/preferences/run artifacts, policy-changed/reference-unchanged hashes) are preserved.
